name: Vantus Rune: Tides
tooltip:
Vantus Rune: Tides
Level 90
Unlimited range
1.5 sec cast
Attune yourself to the energies of the targeted Ula'tek Temple raid boss, increasing your Versatility by 162 when fighting that boss. This effect lasts for an entire week.

You can only use one Vantus Rune per week.
